name: id
description: An unique ID used assigned to the modal. This id is used to generate various UI component ids, like the modal overlay, modal dialog itself, etc. If empty or not provided, an unique identifier in this format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx is generated.

name: header
description: The header section configuration. See below for all available parameters. All parameter below starting with header. belongs to header configuration object. These header.* parameter names follow javascript object key access format. Please DO NOT use the header.* parameters as they are! It wont work.

name: header.enabled
description: If not set to true, the header section will not be generated.

name: header.title
description: The title text for the header section

name: header.titleTag
description: The html tag name for title. Defaults to h2.

name: header.content
description: If you dont want title and replace it with custom content, pass the custom html content for header here.

name: header.cssClass
description: Additional css class for header

name: header.inlineStyles
description: Additional inline css styles for header

name: footer
description: The footer section configuration. See below for all available parameters. All parameter below starting with footer. belongs to footer configuration object. These footer.* parameter names follow javascript object key access format. Please DO NOT use the footer.* parameters as they are! It wont work.

name: footer.enabled
description: If true footer will be generated.

name: footer.mode
description: Footer has 3 different modes: alert, confirm and custom. The default is the alert. In alert mode footer only generates a close button centered inside the footer area. You can configure this close button using footer.closeButton.* parameters. In confirm mode a close button and an ok button is generated which are spaced around the footer area, making it a confirm dialog. Like the close button you can configure ok button using footer.okButton.* parameters. In custom mode you are responsible to provide the content for the footer section.

name: footer.content
description: When footer.mode is set to custom, this parameter is where you set your custom footer content.

name: footer.onOk
description: Footer ok button click event callback. This only applies if footer mode is set to confirm or in your custom content there is an element with cssClass.modalOk css class. In here you can handle any processing that should happen when the ok button is clicked. Note that inside onOk callback this refers to the Modal object. So, you can make use of it to access modal DOM elements, and hiding the modal when done.

name: footer.cssClass
description: Additional css classes to be passed to footer element.

name: footer.inlineStyles
description: Additional inline css styles to be passed to footer element.

name: footer.okButton
description: The Ok button configuration. All footer.okButton.* params belongs to this object

name: footer.okButton.text
description: Ok button text. Defaults to Ok. Change this to your liking.

name: footer.okButton.cssClass
description: Additional css class for OK button. If you want to use your own button style matching your theme this is the right place for you.

name: footer.okButton.inlineStyles
description: Pass on inline css styles to the Ok button

name: footer.okButton.iconClass
description: Use a font icon class. For example any font-awesome icon class.

name: footer.okButton.iconPosition
description: Place the icon on left or right. Default is left.

name: footer.closeButton
description: The Close button configuration. All footer.closeButton.* params belongs to this object

name: footer.closeButton.text
description: Close button text. Defaults to Close. Change this to your liking.

name: footer.closeButton.cssClass
description: Additional css class for OK button. If you want to use your own button style matching your theme this is the right place for you.

name: footer.closeButton.inlineStyles
description: Pass on inline css styles to the Close button

name: footer.closeButton.iconClass
description: Use a font icon class. For example any font-awesome icon class.

name: footer.closeButton.iconPosition
description: Place the icon on left or right. Default is left.

name: autoWidth
description: Should the modal be as wide as the content? If set to true, the width parameter will be ignored!

name: width
description: The width object, it will be ignored if autoWidth is set to true.

name: width.value
description: The width value

name: width.unit
description: The width unit. Can be px/vw or any other css unit applicable.

name: maxWidth
description: The maximum width object. If set modal width will not surpass given value.

name: maxWidth.value
description: The maximum width value

name: maxWidth.unit
description: The maximum width unit. Can be px/vw or any other css unit applicable.

name: minWidth
description: The minimum width object. If set modal width will at least be equal to this value.

name: minWidth.value
description: The minimum width value

name: minWidth.unit
description: The minimum width unit. Can be px/vw or any other css unit applicable.

name: autoHeight
description: Should the modal be as high as the content? If set to true, the height parameter will be ignored!

name: height
description: The height object, it will be ignored if autoHeight is set to true.

name: height.value
description: The height value

name: height.unit
description: The height unit. Can be px/vw or any other css unit applicable.

name: maxHeight
description: The maximum height object. If set modal height will not surpass given value.

name: maxHeight.value
description: The maximum height value

name: maxHeight.unit
description: The maximum height unit. Can be px/vw or any other css unit applicable.

name: minHeight
description: The minimum height object. If set modal height will at least be equal to this value.

name: minHeight.value
description: The minimum height value

name: minHeight.unit
description: The minimum height unit. Can be px/vw or any other css unit applicable.

name: position
description: Determines the modal dialog's position on the screen. It has one of these 9 possible values ['top-left', 'top-center', 'top-right', 'middle-left', 'middle-center', 'middle-right', 'bottom-left', 'bottom-center', 'bottom-right']. Using one of these values you can control where the modal will show up. For example using bottom-right option, you can display the modal at the bottom right corner. A good position to display if the visitor want's to subscribe to a newsletter or something. Though most of the time you will want the modal to be centered in screen, but some time you may want to do otherwise.

name: shiftDistance
description: This shift distance is internally used by the modal, in conjunction with the modal manager's baseShiftDistance param to calculate if the modal needs to be shifted from it's original position. This cannot be used to configure a specific modal's shifting distance.

name: transitionDuration
description: The duration in milliseconds for the fade in/out animation to complete. You can pass in 0 to disable the fading animation. This can also be configured for each individual modal instance.

name: cssClass
description: An object that accepts additional css classes for modal dialog, ok and close buttons. This object combines the class names from modal manager's cssClass parameter objects. So in modal manager's cssClass object you can specify all css classes common for all modals, then in each modal you can assign unique classes to alter look and feel for each modal.

name: cssClass.modal
description: Additional css class names for modal dialog

name: cssClass.modalOk
description: Additional css class names for modal ok button in footer

name: cssClass.modalClose
description: Additional css class names for modal close button in footer

name: onShow
description: A callback which is called after modal is displayed in the page. It is fired after modal is added in DOM and animations ended. This is the perfect place to bind any events or transform any UI elements. For example beautifying select elements with custom components etc.

name: onHide
description: A callback which is called after modal removed from DOM. Its is where you can cleanup any resources that pertains to this modal instance.

name: draggable
description: Determines whether or not modal is draggable.

name: dragHandle
description: The element to be used as drag handle. If not provided or empty, the modal header will become the drag handle. If header is not available, then entire modal becomes drag handle. If a value is provided, it will be treated as an element id. If the element is found it will be used as drag handle. Else, the modal itself becomes drag handle, that is you can click and drag anywhere on the modal dialog. Dragging is an experimental feature!

name: userSelect
description: Enables user to select text content on the modal. By default it is disabled, so user's cannot select select text on the modal.

name: xButton
description: The close or X button settings for this modal instance. the modal manager's xButton parameter object defines common X button content and styling. And, this xButton object affects this modal's X button only.

name: xButton.enabled
description: Enable the close button or X button

name: xButton.content
description: The button content. Defaults to X character. But you can provide any content you like, including text, image and font icons.

name: xButton.cssClass
description: Additional css classes for the button

name: xButton.cssClass
description: Additional css classes for the button

name: xButton.inlineStyles
description: Additional css inline styles for the button

name: delayInMilliSeconds
description: By specifying a delay in milliseconds you can make the modal delay it's display and after display actions, like event bindings. You can use this in scenarios, where you need to display a popup N seconds after page loads.

name: backDrop
description: Modal back drop. This element is a fixed positioned div element, that covers entire visible viewport. And, this also acts as the parent container of the modal dialog.

name: bgColor
description: A color that can have alpha transparency. like the rgba format. This acts as back drop's background color.

name: opacity
description: The backdrop opacity. Do note that, having opacity less than 1, will turn entire backdrop including the modal dialog with transparent! So use this carefully.

name: body
description: The mandatory modal content configuration object. Modal header and footer can be omitted, but body object must be present. See all the body.* parameters below to learn about what it supports.

name: body.contentType
description: The modal content type. Any one of these values are supported: ['html', 'iframe', 'function', 'ajax', 'image', 'youtube-video', 'template']. Defaults to 'html'.

name: body.content
description: when body.contentType === 'html', use this to provide the modal with html markup as string to display inside modal body.

name: body.iframeCode
description: The iframe embed code when body.contentType === 'iframe'. The embed code must be valid with <iframe> tag present. A check is made for validity using regex.

name: body.functionName
description: If body.contentType === 'function', use this property to supply the modal with a JS function or a valid function name that is available on global content. This is required!

name: body.functionArguments
description: If body.functionName is the name of the function, then any arguments to be passed to body.functionName. Can be any thing.

name: body.ajaxParams
description: if body.contentType === 'ajax', this is where you pass the ajax related options. See detailed parameters below.

name: body.ajaxParams.contentDataType
description: The response format from the AJAX call. Can only be json or html. Default is html.

name: body.ajaxParams.url
description: AJAX url to load. Must be a valid http URL

name: body.ajaxParams.method
description: The http method for this ajax call. can be any http method.

name: body.ajaxParams.header
description: An object containing http headers. Header names as this object's key and header value as property value. For example: {'Content-Type' : 'application/json'}

name: body.ajaxParams.transformHtml
description: A transformer method that can further process or transform loaded html content via ajax. This can be a function or global function name. The function must return content as string, usually the processed modal body content markup.

name: body.ajaxParams.transformJson
description: Similar to body.ajaxParams.transformHtml, but for JSON data. Same rules apply.

name: body.ajaxParams.timeoutMs
description: Timeout in milliseconds till the ajax operation aborts. Defaults to 30 seconds or 30000 milliseconds. Adjust this timeout based on your requirements or expectations.

name: body.ajaxParams.decodeParams
description: if the http method is GET, then removes the encoding from ajax url. While this may be desired from some cases, but for most cases you should keep the url with query params encoded so that the url can remain safe. Just added this for edge cases, where it may be required.

name: body.ajaxParams.data
description: AJAX request data. Data can be a plain object or FormData. Note that as of now, file upload using FormData is not supported. This data can be used for any HTTP methods. if used for GET, it will turn into query params.

name: body.imageParams
description: Required only if body.contentType === 'image'. See options below.

name: body.imageParams.url
description: Image url. Required.

name: body.imageParams.alt
description: Image alt text.

name: body.imageParams.title
description: Image title.

name: body.imageParams.cssClass
description: Additional image css class

name: body.imageParams.inlineStyles
description: Additional css inline styles for the image

name: body.imageParams.caption
description: Caption content to be displayed at the bottom of the image.

name: body.imageParams.captionTemplate
description: If a valid <template> element ID is provided, that template's content is used as caption content. In this case the usual caption parameter above is ignored.

name: body.imageParams.captionCssClass
description: Additional css classes to be added to caption element.

name: body.cssClass
description: Additional css classes to be added to modal body.

name: body.inlineStyles
description: Additional css inline styles to be added to modal body.

name: body.videoUrl
description: If body.contentType === 'youtube-video', pass the video url here. As of now only YouTube video urls are supported, including shorts.

name: body.templateId
description: ID of a <template> element. Usable when body.contentType === 'template'. In this case the template element content becomes the modal body content.
